name: Towson
seo_title: Towson Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 9 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Towson, Maryland for 2026: 9 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Towson, the Baltimore County seat, mixes a downtown tree lighting with a National Park Service mansion open house, train gardens and several Nutcracker productions at Towson University.
celebrates: Towson's season opens around the Baltimore County Christmas Tree Lighting at Olympian Park on Friday, December 4, where the Towson Chamber of Commerce lists the Towson Christmas Tree, Santa and friends, inflatable decorations, Christmas lights and hot chocolate. A week later the Towson Main Street Collaborative hosts a Winter Garden on Delaware Avenue. Hampton National Historic Site opens its decorated mansion on December 5. Towson University's Stephens Hall stages Nutcracker productions, and the Kenilworth train garden runs from November 21. Nearby Timonium and Lutherville add the Maryland State Fairgrounds and the Fire Museum of Maryland.
lastyear: Hampton National Historic Site posted photo galleries of Holidays at Hampton for 2024 and 2025, with 88 images from 2024 and 10 from 2025 on the National Park Service site. A 2025 photo caption shows the ConneXions Academy choir performing in the mansion's Great Hall, and another shows a young visitor holding a holiday craft in the Orangery while Historic Hampton Inc. handed out refreshments. The Towson Chamber also held the county tree lighting at Olympian Park in 2024, on December 6.
facts: Hampton's holiday open house tells the story of the people who lived and worked at the estate between 1783 and 1948, according to Visit Baltimore County. The National Park Service says the mansion is decorated for Christmases from Hampton's Revolutionary origins through the Reconstruction Era, and the decorations stay up from December 3, 2026 through January 10, 2027. The Towson Winter Garden on December 11 is run by the Towson Main Street Collaborative and offers craft vendors, food, free hot chocolate and a fire pit.
trains: Towson has its own train garden at The Shops at Kenilworth, open from November 21 to January 3. In Lutherville, the Fire Museum of Maryland opens its Holiday Train Garden on November 28. For real rides, Baltimore's B&O Railroad Museum runs its Holiday Festival of Trains and The Polar Express Train Ride, and the Baltimore Streetcar Museum offers Santa's Streetcar. Both museums have pages on this site with hours, tickets and Christmas details.

kidfact: At Hampton, kids can make an ornament from wood from a tree that grew at the estate and earn a Jr Ranger badge.
faq: When is the Towson Christmas tree lighting?

The Baltimore County Christmas Tree Lighting is Friday, December 4, 2026, at Olympian Park in downtown Towson. The Towson Chamber of Commerce lists Santa and friends, inflatable decorations, Christmas lights and hot chocolate. Check the chamber's page for the exact start time before you go.
Is there a free Christmas event at Hampton?

Yes. Holidays at Hampton on Saturday, December 5, 2026 is free, according to the National Park Service. The open house runs 11 am to 5 pm, with an ornament craft, cider and cookies while supplies last, music in the Great Hall and a Jr Ranger program for kids.
Where is the train garden in Towson?

The Holiday Train Garden is at The Shops at Kenilworth in Towson from November 21 to January 3. The center lists daily hours and a downloadable Train Scavenger Hunt. In Lutherville, the Fire Museum of Maryland also opens a train garden on November 28.
Are there Nutcracker shows in Towson?

Yes. Towson University's Stephens Hall hosts the Mid-Atlantic Center for the Performing Arts Nutcracker on November 28 and the MidAtlantic Youth Ballet's Unmistakably Maryland Nutcracker on December 4, 5 and 6. The listings are on this page with ticket prices.
What is near Towson for a bigger day out?

Baltimore's Inner Harbor has Christmas Village, the B&O Railroad Museum runs holiday trains and the Maryland Zoo has Holly Days. Our Baltimore guide lists these with dates and prices, and several are a short drive from Towson, including The Polar Express Train Ride and the Mayor's Christmas Parade.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Towson for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Holiday Train Garden at The Shops at Kenilworth) into January 3, with the Maryland Holiday Light Spectacular at the Fairgrounds in Timonium, the Baltimore County Christmas Tree Lighting (December 4) and Holidays at Hampton (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Towson

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Towson, counting Timonium and Lutherville
  • Free: Holidays at Hampton on December 5 and the Towson University community dance Nutcracker Suite (other prices on each listing)
  • Meet Santa: the Baltimore County Christmas Tree Lighting with Santa and friends, and the light show at the Maryland State Fairgrounds
  • Parades and tree lightings: Baltimore County Christmas Tree Lighting at Olympian Park (December 4)
  • Trains: Holiday Train Garden at The Shops at Kenilworth and the train garden at the Fire Museum of Maryland in Lutherville
  • Nutcrackers: Mid-Atlantic Center for the Performing Arts (November 28), MidAtlantic Youth Ballet (December 4 to 6) and the Towson University community dance Nutcracker Suite
  • Season: November 27 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Towson families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Baltimore, which covers Christmas Village in Baltimore at the Inner Harbor, The Polar Express Train Ride at the B&O Railroad Museum, the Mayor's Christmas Parade and Charm City Lights at Druid Hill Park.
